prompt_messages.content: /no_think You are a planner. Reply with ONLY a JSON object (no markdown, no prose, no thinking). Use EXACTLY these field names: id, goal_id, version, tasks, dependencies, branches. Each task uses: id, description, action, target, risk_class, optional rollback{trigger,action,safety_guard}, optional verification{what,how,expected}, optional preconditions (array of {description, fact, established_by}), optional parallel_group, optional blast_radius. preconditions MUST be objects with description, fact, established_by fields — NEVER strings. established_by MUST be the id of an earlier task in the plan that establishes the fact, or 'env' if it is an environment fact (not a task output). Do NOT use fact names or descriptions as established_by — use the task id. Each dependency uses: from_task, to_task, kind, optional reason. Each branch uses: id, kind (fan_out|fan_in), tasks (list of task id STRINGS, not objects), join (MUST be 'all', 'any', or 'quorum'). branches is OPTIONAL — omit it if the plan has no fan-out/fan-in structure. Do NOT put rollback or verification inside branches. High/critical risk tasks MUST have rollback AND verification. All tasks with risk_class high or critical MUST include both rollback and verification objects. Example shape: {"id":"plan-x","goal_id":"g","version":1,"tasks":[{"id":"backup","description":"Back up the database","action":"backup","target":"db","risk_class":"medium","preconditions":[{"description":"db is reachable","fact":"db_healthy","established_by":"env"}]},{"id":"migrate","description":"Apply schema migration","action":"migrate","target":"schema","risk_class":"high","rollback":{"trigger":"migration fails","action":"restore from backup","safety_guard":"verify backup integrity"},"verification":{"what":"schema version","how":"run checks","expected":"v2"}}],"dependencies":[{"from_task":"backup","to_task":"migrate","kind":"hard"}]}

response_content: {"id":"plan-ci-06-precommit-hooks","goal_id":"ci-06-precommit-hooks","version":1,"tasks":[{"id":"define_hooks","description":"Define pre-commit hook configuration","action":"define","target":"pre-commit hooks","risk_class":"medium","preconditions":[{"description":"tools installed","fact":"tools_available","established_by":"env"}]},{"id":"create_template_repo","description":"Create shared template repository for hooks","action":"create","target":"template repo","risk_class":"medium","preconditions":[{"description":"hook config defined","fact":"hooks_defined","established_by":"define_hooks"}]},{"id":"install_hooks","description":"Install pre-commit hooks across repositories via automation","action":"install","target":"repositories","risk_class":"high","rollback":{"trigger":"installation fails","action":"remove hooks","safety_guard":"verify absence of hooks"},"verification":{"what":"hooks are installed","how":"check each repo","expected":"all repos have hooks installed"}},{"id":"enforce_ci","description":"Enforce pre-commit hooks in CI pipeline","action":"enforce","target":"CI","risk_class":"critical","rollback":{"trigger":"CI fails","action":"disable hooks in CI","safety_guard":"verify CI stability"},"verification":{"what":"CI pass rate","how":"monitor CI logs","expected":"CI passes with hooks"}}],"dependencies":[{"from_task":"define_hooks","to_task":"create_template_repo","kind":"hard"},{"from_task":"create_template_repo","to_task":"install_hooks","kind":"hard"},{"from_task":"install_hooks","to_task":"enforce_ci","kind":"hard"}]}
